notes.title: 1.1.6 - minor updates
notes.content:
1.1.6 update notes (without spoilers!):
- Bridget can now be more helpful if she thinks you are Fhwegh
- If you get outside before the gates are opened, you can go to the Phfilweg Sweg as you might expect
- Ensure if you refaww3g your loyalty to the Oooshi you become evviau once again
- lots of minor typos and fixes

Thanks to everyone who reported weirdnesses! Be good!

Minor fixes, as unspoilered as possible:

- don't get trapped in the grvngnrg
- don't let Susan say hello when she's argigvagt
- or Fifi, for that matter
- don't have invisible girls drag you to prize-giving
- ensure you have to put the asegweg back in the weghwqeg if you've added webw for it to have ... special effects
- don't crash in the intro if you've whsdghs Weerweg
- add a joke about hockey sticks
